dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge forming a smooth parabolic curve from the posterior base to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a minimal pixel radius resulting in a sharp point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree positive slope relative to the longitudinal dorsal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Vertical height-to-base width ratio of approximately 1.3:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Large-radius convex curve exhibiting a gradual slope from the cranial region toward the rostrum.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, blunt beak extension with high pixel thickness relative to its length.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle measured at the shallow indentation where the melon profile transitions to the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple small, circular white depigmented pockmarks/lesions visible on the dorsal surface of the melon and the anterior flank below the dorsal fin.
